source_semantics.penetration: all enemies occupying the same path cell
source_semantics.area: enemies in nearby path cells; Stage 1 prototype uses radius 1 path cell when a unit has no explicit radius
source_semantics.transfer: damage transfers to nearby targets and drops 10% each transfer
source_semantics.freeze: stun/disable plus damage for a defined duration
source_semantics.stun: action disabled for a defined duration
source_semantics.block: skill use disabled for a defined duration

prototype_only.note: These values fill source blanks for the alpha and are not final balance.
